notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Program.Trade.cs implements the trade loop end to end: SMSG_TRADE_STATUS state machine (begin/open/accept/unaccept-reset/close codes), SMSG_TRADE_STATUS_EXTENDED item+gold snapshots for both sides, the UI-TradeFrame four-piece shell, both names, 7 slots per side with click-to-place (CMSG_SET_TRADE_ITEM) and click-to-clear (CMSG_CLEAR_TRADE_ITEM), gold entry (CMSG_SET_TRADE_GOLD), Trade/Cancel buttons (CMSG_ACCEPT_TRADE / CMSG_CANCEL_TRADE), partner-accepted indicator, and the incoming-trade invitation popup with CMSG_BEGIN_TRADE.
